name: boringstack-api
description: Production-ready Bun + Elysia + Drizzle API starter template

scripts.test: bun run build:templates && NODE_ENV=test bun run scripts/quality/run-tests-clean.ts tests
scripts.test:coverage: bun run build:templates && NODE_ENV=test bun run scripts/quality/check-coverage.ts
scripts.test:security: bun run build:templates && NODE_ENV=test SECURITY_SPEC=true bun run scripts/quality/run-tests-clean.ts security-spec
scripts.dev: ./scripts/dev/preflight-host-dev.sh && bun run build:templates && bun run --watch src/index.ts
scripts.db:prepare: bun run db:migrate && bun run db:seed
scripts.build: bun run build:templates && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run lint:meta && bun run check:lint-meta-docs && bun run knip
scripts.validate: bun run check && bun run test
scripts.new:subject: bun run scripts/codegen/new-subject.ts

//overrides._: Why these transitive deps are pinned. Keep each entry in sync with the matching `overrides` key — enforced by the package-override-parity lint-meta rule.
//overrides.@typescript-eslint/utils: Single @typescript-eslint/utils resolution across the workspace so the shared @boring-stack-pkg ESLint plugins all load the same utils version. The UI and docs apps mirror this exact pin; a mismatch makes the custom plugins resolve divergent utils copies and fail to load.
//overrides.axios: Pin patched axios (GHSA-gcfj-64vw-6mp9 and related SSRF/credential-leak advisories, then GHSA-r4gj-5m52-g5wh, GHSA-vh66-26gq-q6x8, GHSA-x97p-jq2g-jp4f). 1.18.0 is vulnerable; 1.20.0 patches it. Pulled in transitively via @sendgrid/mail -> @sendgrid/client. Mirrored by apps/docs.
//overrides.@grpc/grpc-js: Pin patched @grpc/grpc-js (GHSA-f596-whhp-79r4, GHSA-m9gg-hp2v-232j). 1.14.4 is vulnerable; 1.14.5 patches it. Pulled in transitively via @opentelemetry/otlp-grpc-exporter-base, which accepts ^1.14.3.
//overrides.form-data: Pin patched form-data (GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx CRLF injection via unescaped multipart field names); 4.0.5 is vulnerable, 4.0.6 patches it. Pulled in transitively via @sendgrid/mail -> @sendgrid/client -> axios. Excluded from the install quarantine while <7 days old.
//overrides.ioredis: Force a single ioredis resolution across the tree. bullmq 5.80.2 exact-pins ioredis@5.10.1, so bumping the top-level dep to 5.11.1 otherwise leaves bullmq on its own nested 5.10.1 copy — two ioredis instances whose RedisOptions types are structurally incompatible (tsc fails on new Redis(options) calls). This override collapses bullmq's nested copy onto 5.11.1 too; 5.10.1 -> 5.11.1 is a semver patch and the Redis/BullMQ integration tests verify runtime compatibility. Drop this once bullmq advances its own ioredis pin.
//overrides.protobufjs: Pin patched protobufjs (GHSA-j3f2-48v5-ccww). 7.6.1 is vulnerable; 7.6.5 patches it. Transitive via the OpenTelemetry OTLP exporter (build/telemetry path).
//overrides.smol-toml: Pin patched smol-toml (GHSA-r4xh-jqrq-34v2). 1.8.0 is vulnerable; 1.9.0 patches it. Transitive via knip (lint-time only). Mirrored in every app by the override-parity rule.
//overrides.source-map-js: Pin patched source-map-js (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q). 1.2.1 is vulnerable; 1.2.2 patches it. Transitive via postcss / css-tree build tooling. Mirrored in every app by the override-parity rule.
